settings.title: CarPlay theme
settings.description: Names a CarPlay Ultra theme in the car's wireless CarPlay identification (through the Wireless CarPlay mod), so the iPhone can download it from Apple and offer theme sync. Needed by CarPlay Ultra-Lite's Ultra theme; turn it off with CarPlay Ultra off, or if CarPlay stays black. Restart the head unit afterwards and forget and pair the iPhone again. The EV vehicle identity Apple Maps uses for routing is not changed by it.

settings.title: CarPlay start session
settings.description: Answers the iPhone's CarPlay availability message with the car's Wi-Fi, AirPlay identity and the CarPlay theme asset, as LIVI does, so the iPhone actually fetches the theme. Needs CarPlay Ultra-Lite to have run CarPlay once (it saves the AirPlay identity). Turn it off, with the theme, if CarPlay stays black.
